messages:
maria: Heads-up — seeing a spike in fncall validation rejects in prod. Most are from the payment-tool adapter: error says "missing required field: status". Opening a thread to discuss console annotations + telemetry sampling so SDK/infra can triage faster.
josh: Do we have any example payloads landing anywhere? metrics only show counts + reject codes atm.
srinivasan: Not really. We scrub payloads aggressively for PII. We could sample a tiny percentage of failing fncalls, redact known-sensitive fields, and store snippets behind internal ACLs. Need to confirm with legal for payment fields.
maria: Proposal: add an "error_annotation" block in the console (and API debug endpoint) that contains "reason", "json_path", and a link to an internal redacted snippet. Example annotation: `error_annotation: {"reason":"missing_field","path":"response.status"}`. Tag metrics with `fncall_error_reason` and `fncall_schema_version`.
henry: Routing concern — currently we fallback to a degenerate text model when structured output fails, which causes noisy user-facing hallucinations. Can we instead return a structured error to rider and optionally route to a permissive adapter only for internal/canary traffic?
opsbot: deploy-bot: starting canary rollout for console-error-annotations -> group=internal, pct=10, sha=abc123 (approx 5m window).
josh: Dashboard ask: add a tile that shows "fncall validation rejects" with top 5 failing json paths + counts, and link to sampled snippets. Add alert when rejects > 0.5% of fncalls over 5m.
srinivasan: Storage/quotas: keeping snippets will increase retention costs. Suggest sample 0.5% of failures by default, cap at 10k snippets/day, rotate redaction keys daily, and TTL snippets to 7 days for canary, 30 days for internal only.
maria: Good constraints. Also enforce that snippet links are only resolvable inside the VPC and require `run_id` and `request_id` for audit. Add `fncall_schema_version` to telemetry so we can correlate spikes with schema rollouts.
henry: UX note: in the console show a one-line "why did this fail?" plus a suggested fix snippet, e.g. `Ensure response includes top-level "status" enum` and a quick sample patch for the SDK.
josh: I'll take dashboard + alert wiring. Srinivasan, can you own the sampling & redaction plan and share a short doc? Maria will own canary plan and the console copy/annotation shape.
srinivasan: Will do. I'll draft retention/redaction rules and a sampling matrix, and ping legal/security.
maria: tagging @security-bot for review of redaction rules and payment-field exceptions. Please chime in if any compliance blocker.
security-bot: security-bot: quick check queued — please add exact list of payment-tool keys you might need for debugging. We will advise on allowed redaction patterns.
maria: Also: do not change routing defaults in this rollout. We will test annotation visibility + dashboard first, then evaluate routing fallback changes in a later canary.
henry: Sounds good. One more thing: add a small gauge metric for "fncall_sampled_snippets_stored" so we can monitor storage usage before it spikes.
josh: ack. I'll add the gauge and a cost alarm.
maria: Thanks everyone — next steps: Josh dashboard, Srinivasan sampling doc, Maria canary playbook. We'll reconvene after canary data (ETA ~24h).
